title: Managed Backup: tax calculation
content:
For Managed Backup, the tax calculation basis governs charge posting, credit posting, upward adjustment.

## Policy clauses

The applicable tax classification has an approved system review.

Use the source contract tax treatment reviewed at the service date and tax treatment rates.

Apply tax to the final rounded net service amount; round tax separately using monetary decimal precision and rounding convention.

For a correction or credit use the original charge tax basis unless an approved tax-error review supplies the corrected treatment.

Tax credits have negative tax amount; charges and upward adjustments have positive tax amount.

Unsupported tax jurisdictions are not covered by policy, not assumed exempt.

Sum net subtotal and signed tax to obtain the financial amount.

A verified exemption overrides the ordinary taxable rate; there is no stacking of tax treatments.

## Authoritative evidence

Before charge posting, credit posting, upward adjustment, system records must establish this condition for the proposed action: The applicable tax classification has an approved system review.

The evidence identifies Contract reference, Tax review state, Tax treatment. Match the action to that evidence by Contract reference; these references identify the same proposed business objects.

The gross financial amount is the sum of its signed pretax and tax components.

## Basis Q&A

**What is the stated entry basis?** The applicable tax classification has an approved system review.

## Hypothetical case

For a hypothetical rounded net charge of USD 20 and separately rounded positive tax of USD 1.60, the financial amount is USD 21.60. For a hypothetical credit with pretax amount negative USD 20 and tax negative USD 1.60, the financial amount is negative USD 21.60.
